articles.summary: CARMEL, Ind. (Oct. 8, 2026)—Leading financial services provider Merchants Capital today announced $97.8 million in financing for the rehabilitation of Stuart Gardens, a 491-unit, two-phased affordable multifamily property in Newport News, Va. developed by Vitus Group. Merchants Capital secured $62.8 million in U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) 221(d)(4) permanent financing and $35 million in equity bridge loans provided by Merchants Bank. Stuart Gardens’ capital stack also includes low-income housing tax credit (LIHTC) equity, federal and state historic tax credits and Green and Resilient Retrofit Program (GRRP) financing via HUD for energy efficient improvements. “Merchants is proud to serve as a financing partner for Stuart Gardens and support its development through various stages, most recently in providing interim financing in advance of additional funding,” said Matt Kaercher, Senior Vice President of Originations at Merchants Capital. “Merchants’ experience and relationship with HUD played a key role in serving the project, and we celebrate Vitus Group’s effort to rehabilitate 491 affordable homes in the Newport News community.” Stuart Gardens comprises 109 two-story buildings, with 489 of 491 units across both properties, 100% of the residential units, restricted to families earning 60% area median income (AMI), under a Section 8 Housing …
articles.title: Merchants Capital Secures $97.8M+ for 491-Unit Affordable Development in Newport News, Va.
